name: Baltic Bangers
author: Bad Ideas Works
description: Herring, saunas, ferries and long dark winters, straight from the studio's own shoreline.

forms.pitch: Once a year, host a midsummer festival with bonfires, flower wreaths and questionable dancing.
forms.connects: A good festival pays out enough {resource.noun} to get you through winter.

forms.pitch: Add a sauna hierarchy where sitting on the top bench is a political statement.
forms.connects: Top-bench regulars make it easier to {objective.verb}.

forms.pitch: Catalogue every fish in the sea, including twelve kinds of herring that look exactly the same.
The local radio host comments live on everything your {protagonist.noun} does.
When the sea freezes, an ice road opens between the islands, and it closes without warning.
forms.connects: It is the fastest way to {objective.verb}, and the fastest way to fall in.

forms.pitch: Seasonal mushroom-foraging runs in the forest, against fiercely competitive grandmothers.
forms.connects: A good mushroom spot becomes a secret worth more than {resource.noun}.

forms.pitch: A fully voiced herring opera plays every time you land a catch.
A full trade network of coastal towns with shifting prices for salt, amber and herring.

hook.text: Somewhere on a cold northern coast, [a] {protagonist.noun} has to {objective.verb} before the daylight runs out.

pitchThreat.text: Out here, {threat.clause}, and there's never enough {resource.noun} before the ice comes.

mightWork.text: But long dark winters make for great cozy tension, and {mechanic.noun} fits that mood perfectly.
